name: Compact Voxel Octree Raycasting
definition: A raycasting algorithm that traverses a compacted voxel octree (SVO) using an explicit stack to handle non-sequential memory layouts, decoding node masks on-the-fly to determine traversal order and leaf status.
summary: Compact Voxel Octree Raycasting is a CPU-based algorithm that optimizes sparse voxel octree traversal by compacting active ray-voxel interactions and decoding node masks on-the-fly to improve memory bandwidth and cache locality.
